topic: Five signs your kitchen ventilation needs attention

slides.headline: Five signs your ventilation is already failing.
slides.subline: None of these fix themselves, and most get worse quietly.

slides.title: The first three you will notice
slides.intro: These show up during service, when the kitchen is at its busiest.

items.title: Grease dripping from the filters
items.text: The filters are loaded, so grease is being pulled through them.

items.title: Smoke hanging over the cooking line
items.text: It should be taken away as it rises, not left to spread.

items.title: The kitchen stays hot with the fan on
items.text: Heat is staying in the room instead of leaving the building.

slides.title: The last two you hear and smell
slides.intro: By this point the problem is usually in the duct or the fan.

items.title: The fan note has changed
items.text: New vibration or a louder pitch usually means wear or build-up.

items.title: Cooking smells in the dining room
items.text: Air is finding its way in, not out, which is the worst sign.

slides.note_text: Two or more at once needs a system check, not a filter wash.

slides.headline: Two signs or more? Book a check.
slides.subline: We inspect, repair and replace across Doha.

caption_en:
Five signs, and not one of them is cosmetic.

Grease dripping from the filters. Smoke hanging over the cooking line during service. A kitchen that stays hot with the exhaust running. A fan note that has changed. Cooking smells arriving in the dining room instead of leaving the building.

On their own these look small. Together they mean the system has stopped doing its job, and cleaning alone will not bring it back.

We inspect, repair and replace exhaust systems across Doha. Send a photo of your hood and filters for a first opinion.
